text:
Which statement about sodium is correct?
A
It is a reactive grey solid which does not conduct electricity.
B
It is a very reactive element that forms ions with a single negative charge.
C
It reacts slowly with water to form oxygen.
D
It reacts rapidly with water to form its hydroxide.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a reactive grey solid which does not conduct electricity.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a very reactive element that forms ions with a single negative charge.

options.label: C
options.text: It reacts slowly with water to form oxygen.

options.label: D
options.text: It reacts rapidly with water to form its hydroxide.
